name: generate-image-speaker-event
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour annoncer un talk (1 speaker) à une conférence
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - replace 'Speaker name' by %NAME% - replace 'Talk title' by %TITLE%. Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - integrate the target conference name %CONFERENCE% (and replace the yellow square by the logo of the conference from the %CONF_PHOTO% file if provided). - replace the white square by the speaker photo from this %PHOTO% file if provided. Please don't modify the name of the speaker, the conference name, and the title of the talk.

name: generate-image-2-speaker-event
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour annoncer un talk en binôme (2 speakers) à une conférence
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - replace 'Speaker 1' by %NAME% - replace 'Speaker 2' by %NAME2% - replace 'Talk title' by %TITLE%. Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - integrate the target conference name %CONFERENCE% (and replace the top white rectangle by the conference logo from %CONF_PHOTO% if provided). - replace the first speaker white square (above 'Speaker 1') by the first speaker photo from %PHOTO% if provided. - replace the second speaker white square (above 'Speaker 2') by the second speaker photo from %PHOTO2% if provided. Please don't modify the names of the speakers, the conference name, and the title of the talk.

name: generate-image-3-speaker-event
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour annoncer un talk en trinôme (3 speakers) à une conférence
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - integrate the target conference name %CONFERENCE% (and replace the yellow square by the conference photo from %CONF_PHOTO% if provided) - replace 'Speaker 1' by %NAME% - replace the white square with %PHOTO% if provided - replace 'Speaker 2' by %NAME2% - replace the blue square with %PHOTO2% if provided - replace 'Speaker 3' by %NAME3% - replace the green square with %PHOTO3% if provided - replace 'Talk title' by %TITLE%. name: generate-image-2-talks-event
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour annoncer 2 talks distincts à une même conférence
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - integrate the target conference name %CONFERENCE% (and replace the top-right white rectangle next to the Zenika logo by the conference logo from %CONF_PHOTO% if provided). - in the first talk card (top), replace 'Prénom Nom' by %NAME%, replace 'Titre du talk' by %TITLE%, and replace the white square by the first speaker photo from %PHOTO% if provided. - in the second talk card (bottom), replace 'Prénom Nom' by %NAME2%, replace 'Titre du talk' by %TITLE2%, and replace the white square by the second speaker photo from %PHOTO2% if provided. Please don't modify the names of the speakers, the conference name, and the titles of the talks.

name: generate-image-blog-post

Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - replace the pink square by the photo from this %PHOTO% file if provided. Please don't modify the name of the author and the title of the blog post.

name: generate-image-2-blog-post

Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - replace the first white square by the first author photo from %PHOTO% if provided. - replace the second white square by the second author photo from %PHOTO2% if provided. Please don't modify the names of the authors and the title of the blog post and the ratio of the photos.

name: generate-image-nightclazz
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour un événement NightClazz (1 ou 2 speakers)
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - replace 'Talk title' by %TITLE%. Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - replace 'date' by %DATE% - replace 'hour' by %HOUR% - replace 'Zenika Nantes' by %LOCATION% - replace 'Speaker 1 name' by %NAME% and remove 'Speaker 1 job' - replace the yellow square by the first speaker photo from %PHOTO% if provided - replace 'Speaker 2 name' by %NAME2% and remove 'Speaker 2 job' - replace the green square by the second speaker photo from %PHOTO2% if provided. Please don't modify the names of the speakers, the date, the hour, the location, and the title of the talk.

name: generate-image-nightclazz-partner
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour un événement NightClazz en partenariat
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - replace 'Titre du talk' by %TITLE%. Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - replace 'jour / mois' by %DATE% - replace '18h30-21h' by %HOUR% - replace 'Zenika Nantes' by %LOCATION% - replace 'Nom / prénom' by %NAME% and remove 'Intitulé du poste' - replace the blue square by the speaker photo from %PHOTO% if provided - replace 'Nom du partenaire' by %PARTNER% - replace the white square next to 'En partenariat avec' by the partner logo from %PARTNER_LOGO% if provided. Please don't modify the name of the speaker, the partner name, the date, the hour, the location, and the title of the talk.
